Hello,

We are sorry to hear that your experience may not have met your expectations. The well-being of your pets and your trust are truly important to us.

We would very much like the opportunity to better understand your experience. Please feel free to contact us; we would be happy to take the time to discuss it with you.

We look forward to speaking with you,

The Animomédic Team
I've always received excellent service for my Gustav ❤️🐰 The consultation price is reasonable, the vets take the time to explain everything, and the staff is gentle. Thank you!

I cannot recommend this clinic enough. We had such a difficult decision to make with our beloved cat, Happy. The vets, and all the staff here are so caring and sensitive. They took their time with us, and informed us of all our options. It is so hard to make difficult decisions for our pets when finances are a part of the consideration. This clinic is non-judgmental and compassionate. After our experience with having to let Happy go, the clinic sent us the most thoughtful, personalized and beautiful condolence card in the mail. We were so touched! I recommend this clinic to anyone who is looking for a skilled, conscientious and caring Vet clinic. Thank you so much!

The front desk staff is very nice, but I have to be honest and say that my cat was not getting proper treatment. After not receiving my dental estimate for a while I decided to take him to another place to compare prices. But after his appointment with his new vet we realized that his ear problems that  Animomédic Plateau Mont-Royal Clinique Thought were allergies, for months, was actually a polyp in his ear that needs removed. I was paying for expensive allergen vet prescribed food that was not satisfying him and causing him to yowl everyday. I mentioned his behavior issues to the vet and they were adamant about the allergies being the issue and ordered me to keep on with the food even though his ear problems weren’t improving. He was also out on drops and meds for his ears that may have been doing more harm than help. If this was something that only happened over the span of one visit I would maybe understand that they didn’t catch it at first. But I’ve been to this vet lots of times since winter of 2025 and his ears have been looked at so many times. I only reached out to a new place because I was given a dental estimate months after it was requested, and I just wanted a second opinion since his estimate wasn’t explained to me. Now I’m glad I got a second opinion because my cat was going crazy on his diet and his ear problems weren’t allergies like I had been led to believe for months. As I said, the front desk staff was very nice but I think some important things were missed in his examinations.
Thank you for the 5 stars :)

I am very disappointed with this $128 consultation.

I consulted this clinic because my senior cat seems to be in significant pain when jumping from a height, and I specifically wanted to have his joints examined to understand the cause of his pain.

Unfortunately, I found the examination to be extremely superficial. The veterinarian barely felt him and quickly suggested a joint injection, without really trying to determine the origin of the problem or performing a thorough enough examination, in my opinion.

What particularly shocked me was that during the consultation, while my cat was in her care, she let him jump from a fairly high examination table. My cat was clearly in pain when he landed. I find this particularly inappropriate for an animal who was there specifically for pain when jumping.

I had never met this veterinarian before, and unfortunately, my experience with her was very different from my previous experiences with the vets at this clinic, whom I found much more professional and attentive.

I was primarily expecting a thorough clinical examination and an investigation into the cause of the pain, rather than an immediate treatment plan. I am therefore very disappointed with this consultation and will now be looking for another veterinarian to get a proper assessment of my cat's health.

Predatory billing practices! This clinic attempted to charge me for an unauthorized service that was never performed. When I questioned the invoice, the staff refused to correct it. I had to insistently and assertively demand a refund as they tried numerous times to fabricate ridiculous lies as to why they charged me for something that was never done. When you tell the truth, the story never changes. When you’re trying to scam someone, you change your story as many times as is necessary to try to get your way. Their predatory and dishonest practices are completely transparent and it’s not only pathetic it’s an insult to the patients bringing their pets here. Not to mention the disgusting attitude of the staff: completely condescending, immature, and passive aggressive. As retaliation, the clinic wrote a malicious note in my pet's medical files before transferring them to my new vet. Incredibly unprofessional and petty. Avoid at all costs.
Super fast & super kind
Such a kind and gentle service. Our animals are loved and cared for as if they were their own.

Completely unprofessional, disrespectful, and downright dishonest!
I had a scheduled appointment on Saturday at 3:30 PM and arrived 15 minutes early to ensure everything was on track. Instead of honoring my appointment, this clinic double-booked my exact time slot and chose to take another client who had just arrived with a puppy. It felt like pure greed prioritizing squeezing in extra profit over respecting a scheduled client.
After making me wait past my appointment time, the staff casually informed me that they had no idea how much longer it would take. Refusing to have my time completely disrespected, I decided to leave.
To make matters worse, the veterinarian called me later to apologize, fabricating a story that the other appointment was a "medical emergency." This is a blatant lie. I was sitting right there in the lobby the entire time and saw the client they took ahead of me—it was a perfectly healthy, energetic puppy, not a medical emergency at all.
The dishonesty, lack of professionalism, and complete disregard for people's time at Animomédic Plateau Mont-Royal is unacceptable. If you value honesty, reliable scheduling, and professional behavior, take your pets somewhere else.
We come here for all our animals (cats, rabbits) and they are so kind and professional. We look forward to visiting you again soon, which will mean one of our beloved pets is sick.

A truly caring veterinary clinic. My beloved pet rats, who have long been my cherished little companions, are always well looked after there, with lots of love and attention. And when one of them dies (because sadly their lifespan is quite short), the wonderful team knows how to comfort us in the loss of our friends. A veterinary clinic I warmly recommend, with a competent and very attentive team.

I had a wonderful experience at this clinic; my cat is doing great. I thought I was going to lose my cat, but thanks to them, he's still here. The vet is very kind, and even the reception staff are incredibly friendly. I highly recommend them.

This is the second time Animomedic has come to my rescue and taken in my little Luna in an emergency.
My dog ​​was bitten by another dog during her grooming, and as soon as I noticed the bump, I called Animomedic. They took her in immediately and cared for her. They are so generous. Thank you so much ❤️

An exceptional, competent, and attentive team. My cat Zel has been a patient at Animomedic since she was born, and she's doing wonderfully! I appreciate their availability and the quality of their care, as well as their overall customer service. I've always had pets and have lived on the Plateau for 50 years. I've had the opportunity to visit several clinics, and I consider this one to stand out for all its qualities. I highly recommend them.
I like coming to this clinic because they take really good care of my cat Toffee.

They answered all my questions. They were fast, the experience was smooth, very reassuring when your furball is sick.

I made an appointment at this clinic almost a year ago for my dog's booster vaccination. He had just arrived from France. I had requested a quote beforehand, which seemed perfectly reasonable.

On the day of the appointment, the veterinarian planned to give him his first vaccination and have me come back a month later, which I categorically refused because my 4-year-old dog has been vaccinated every year. She also wanted me to come back for a blood test in the spring to check that my dog ​​was protected against fleas and ticks (even though I regularly give him the necessary tablets), implying that it's normal to do this every year in Quebec. I'm shocked that they would try so hard to extract money from their clients at the expense of the animal's well-being. I thought people went into this profession out of love for animals (which is certainly true of the technicians, who were lovely).

Furthermore, after I mentioned my dog's medical history (ear infections), the vet happily charged me for additional tests and medications without informing me of the cost.

I ended up paying double the initial quote. The check-up wasn't even completed because she didn't examine his paws or teeth.

After speaking with other dog owners in my neighborhood, they unfortunately weren't surprised by my experience, and this clinic has a reputation for this kind of practice. I strongly advise against going there.
Thank you for these 5 wonderful stars, Ms. Farruggello! We are delighted to have Suki as one of our patients.

I took my dog ​​to this clinic for a follow-up appointment after an incident the previous weekend. Everything went very well; the staff was welcoming, and the vet gave me excellent advice. I've therefore decided to continue taking my dog ​​to this clinic.
My Jack was bitten by my ferret and they saved my pet, thank you and well done!
